description: Browse or filter the Discover index across spot tokens, tokenised stocks, perps and prediction markets; each row carries its venues, chains, outcomes and 24h stats. Filter by kind, venue, chain, class, tag or feed; sort by volume_24h, change_24h, market_cap, trending, ends_soon and more; page with cursor. For movers use kind=perp: spot change_24h is noise from illiquid pools unless filtered by liquidity. Prediction rows carry every outcome, so keep limit small (<=5).

chain.description: Comma-separated chains, e.g. ethereum, solana, base.

class.description: Comma-separated asset classes: crypto, tradfi, prediction.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page, same filters and sort.

feed.description: Only one screener feed's members: trending, new or crypto.

max_outcomes.description: Prediction rows: top N outcomes by price, 1-50. Priceless drop first.

min_liquidity_usd.description:
USD floor, >= 0: pool liquidity (spot, stock, prediction) or open interest (perp).
Rows without the figure are dropped.

min_volume_24h_usd.description: USD floor on 24h volume, >= 0. Rows without one are dropped.

sort.description: volume_24h, change_24h, market_cap, new, trending, relevance, ends_soon or name.

tag.description: Comma-separated Polymarket tag slugs (see discover_categories), e.g. politics.

name: discover
title: Discover markets
